content.comment_body: Hello, I am using AWS together with [product_name] Web Editor to monitor my application online. I can see all variable statuses updating correctly in AWS and on the web page. However, I am unable to activate controls like software switches and pushbuttons from the website interface. I am currently located in Colombia, but I have selected the eu-west-2 region in AWS. Could the region selection be causing this problem? How can I resolve this issue? I appreciate any support. Best regards, [user_name]

Are you able to see the status of digital switches and analog values updating according to their actual states in [product_name]? If not, double-check that you haven't added a space to the secret access key when uploading the project. Also, verify that you've enabled the writable property for variables associated with buttons and switches in the configuration.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encounters difficulties interacting with controls (such as software switches and pushbuttons) through their AWS-hosted web application, even though live process data is displayed correctly. The main issue is the inability to operate these controls remotely, which restricts full remote operation. The root cause may be linked to cloud configuration (AWS region, access keys) or permission settings inside the web interface software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects complete remote control capability, including being able to activate software switches, pushbuttons, and other controls via the AWS-based web interface.
